g.text: Metrics cases: a goal, a funnel, one north star
supporting metrics explain the north star; guardrails protect the rest
product, both sides, which business goal now
one metric per stage (AARRR or AARM)
drop the stages the change cannot move
delivered value, with a one-line reason
explain the movement in the north star
which result ships, which result stops
avoid vanity metrics: total signups without retention
